pages.mainAction: The bus stop unfolds two thin legs beneath its bench and steps away as the child and Kim watch.
pages.lighting: Soft evening light with the first warm streetlamps

pages.setting: Sidewalk beside the vacated street corner
pages.mainAction: The child tries to turn the bus stop back while it braces its legs and folds its bench like stubborn arms; Kim observes.
pages.lighting: Deepening dusk under a warm streetlamp
continuityAnchors: same bus stop with two thin legs

pages.setting: Narrow residential alleys beneath balconies and laundry lines
pages.mainAction: Standing on the bench, the child frees the bus-stop roof from a laundry line while Kim wears the fallen striped sock.
pages.lighting: Gentle blue evening light from windows and streetlamps
continuityAnchors: striped sock fallen from laundry line

pages.setting: Evening route past the bakery, fountain square, and playground
pages.mainAction: The child and bus stop listen while Kim closes her eyes, with the busy bakery, splashing fountain, and still-moving swing marking noisy choices.
pages.lighting: Warm bakery glow against a darkening blue evening

pages.mainAction: The bus stop runs after the last bus while waving its timetable, but the bus has stopped just ahead of it again; Kim spins nearby.
pages.heroObject: last bus and pursuing bus stop
pages.lighting: Yellow bus headlights and streetlamps in the night

pages.setting: Quiet curb bay behind the garden
pages.mainAction: The child creates a temporary stop with the child's backpack as a bench and raised flashlight as a tiny moon while Kim waits and the bus opens its door.
pages.lighting: Soft streetlamp light with a bright flashlight glow

pages.setting: Small garden between two trees in a quiet neighborhood
pages.mainAction: The bus stop steps down, spreads its roof between two trees, and settles as a cat sits on its bench; the child and Kim watch from the bus.
pages.heroObject: bus stop settled between two trees
pages.lighting: Hushed moonlight with warm light from the bus
continuityAnchors: same walking bus stop now carried across town

pages.mainAction: The child rests in bed with Kim curled beside the child while the last bus passes softly outside.
pages.lighting: Dim cozy bedside light with cool moonlight at the window
